name: video-transcriber
description: Transcribe any video — 1000+ platforms or a local file — with whisper.cpp, then search across everything you've transcribed. Native Rust binary, runs offline.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Optional. Enables semantic search across your saved transcripts by embedding each one as it is written. Transcription works fully offline without this.
